discussion_comments.comment_body:
@
Acknowledged the `null === unrestricted` guard. That path is **not** how listed DeepSeek is routed after this PR:

- `deepseek-v4-flash` / `deepseek-v4-pro` now declare `supportedFormats: ["openai"]`
- Claude `/v1/messages` and Codex `/v1/responses` therefore **do not** pick `/messages` or `/responses` for those ids
- they fall back to the default transport: `/zen/go/v1/chat/completions` (matches https://opencode.ai/docs/go/)

The remaining `openai-responses` transport is intentional leftover from #3278, not a DeepSeek declaration. Official docs still document `/zen/go/v1/responses` for **GPT 5.6 Luna** (and currently Grok 4.5 on the live docs table). Those models are **not in this registry file**, so `getModelSupportedFormats` returns `null` and a Codex `/v1/responses` client still reaches `/responses`. Removing the transport here would break that path.

Tightening “unknown models must not opt into `/responses`” is a separate follow-up (catalog those models with explicit `supportedFormats`, or change the `null` default). Out of scope for this 400-on-DeepSeek fix. Please do not treat an automated review as approval — see the PR description.
@

Fixed in 46ebf215: incomplete Responses output now suppresses partial tool calls and reports `length` or `content_filter` before considering completed tool calls. Tests cover both truncation reasons with partial tool output.
